title: Mixed Roots at Sacandaga Valley
place: Sacandaga Valley Arts Network, Northville, NY
dateLabel: August 21 at Sacandaga Valley Arts  Network
text: 152 North Main Street, Northville, NY 12134

title: Harvest Fest
text: What a blast! We had fun at Poughkeepsie Farm Project's Harvest Fest, celebrating the power of urban farming. It was great to share the space with amazing vendors and performers.

title: Trail day, trio set
text: Thank you for letting us fill your trail needs as a trio version of Mixed Roots. Rainy Sunday August 24 was fantastic even with the mud. Extra thanks to the great, motivated volunteers from Mohawk Hudson Land Conservancy.

title: Shepard Park
text: Thank you to all of the dancers, listeners, watchers, and supporters at Shepard Park, Lake George. We had a blast. Thank you, Lake George, for the fireworks over the lake after!

title: Troy Night Out
text: Troy Night Out was fantastic! Thank you to all the Caribbean American Heritage Month supporters, dancers, and listeners.

title: Battenkill Fly Fishing Festival
text: Thank you to the Arlington, Vermont Fly Fishing Festival! We had a great time. Glad to see our listeners dancing.

title: Troy pop-up with Oobleck
text: Thank you for sharing a new venue with our friends of Oobleck!

title: Lark Hall
text: We thank Lark Hall here in Albany for hosting us twice in the snow. We appreciated the warm vibes from our audience, especially those dancing!

title: The Eleven @ Lark Hall
text: We absolutely loved playing for you at The Eleven @ Lark Hall. To all a Happy New Year! The best is yet to come. One love.

title: Park Theater
text: Thank you to all who came out to Park Theater Hudson!

title: Celebrate Asylum benefit dinner
text: A fundraising dinner to support local asylum seekers, hosted by Capital District Border Watch.

title: October dance night
text: Thank you to all who danced with us. It was a pleasure enjoying the good vibes.

title: Albany Pine Bush
text: Thank you for seeing us in May!

title: The Linda
place: WAMC Performing Arts Studio, Albany, NY
text: Originally scheduled for February 12, then March 5 at 3:00 pm. Thank you all for enjoying our performance, supported by New York FolkLife. Special shout-out to the dancers!

title: Westminster Commons
text: Thank you to Albany's Westminster Commons for having us play for the first of many more gatherings to come. The Sunday before Thanksgiving was awesome.

title: FolkFest
text: Thanks for checking out the FolkFest hosted by New York Folklore. We were blessed to perform after a tremendously diverse set of talented performers. Dance! Listen! Enjoy the vibes!

title: Stable Gate Farm and Winery
text: Thanks for dancing with us!

title: Illuminate: Masquerade
text: Thank you for checking us out at the end of October!

title: Folklore Fest
text: The first weekend of October we played Capital Wine again on Friday, and we were featured in the inaugural Folklore Fest at Washington Park on Sunday. It was great to see so much of our community there!

title: Stable Gate Fridays
text: We had fun seeing you dance and enjoying the grooves at Stable Gate on a couple of Fridays this late summer. Thanks for joining us!

title: Opening for The Big Takeover
text: We were invited to open for The Big Takeover. Earth Sky Time hosted the show. We always look forward to seeing you dance. Music is love. One love.

title: Alive at Five
text: Thank you to the City of Albany for having us open the first Alive at Five since the pandemic. It was great to play, and we wish the sun had shone more. Keep The Meditations in mind: their sound check was fantastic, and we were sad they were rained out.

title: Opening for Dr. Jah and the Love Prophets
text: Sharing the night with other local reggae enthusiasts, we opened for Dr. Jah and the Love Prophets to welcome summer.

title: Pandemic Halloween
text: We enjoyed the spooky day from 3 to 8 pm with Glass Pony, another indie rock band in the Capital District.

title: Stable Gate residency
place: Stable Gate Farm and Winery, Castleton, NY
text: Our residency continued July 18, August 8, and September 12. It's always a pleasure to play with such great sun, such great people, and such great vibes.

title: Stable Gate Winery
text: Celebrating the world of post-pandemic possibilities.

title: Skyloft, with Robanic
text: Thank you to Skyloft for hosting Robanic and Mixed Roots on Sunday evening. It's always a treat to bring reggae to new venues. Keep dancing!

title: Perfect Blend Winter Series
text: Perfect Blend's Winter Series hosted the (semi) acoustic version of Mixed Roots that morning. With hand drums, guitar, and vocals, Kofi and Pete kept the vibe for morning coffee drinkers.

title: Umana
text: Thanks for dancing the night away! Your first Friday of the month was filled with danceable beats and eclectically exotic flavor.

title: Opening for The Elovaters
text: What a night! Thank you to all who came out and danced!

title: Lunchtime music series
text: Mixed Roots played under the second of four agency buildings during lunch for State workers, neighbors, friends, and local onlookers. Sharing our sound was a pleasure all around.

title: Opening for The Big Takeover
text: The energy was amazing. Thank you to all who came out and enjoyed the fresh night.

title: Franklin Alley Social Club, first anniversary
text: It was a blast. Hope all of the dancers and shuffleboarders had a great time!

title: Umana's fifth anniversary
text: We had the amazing opportunity to share the fifth anniversary celebration with Umana.

title: Snug Harbor
text: Special thanks to RootBrew for hosting us at Snug Harbor. It was a pleasure to play for a very welcoming audience filled with reggae fans!

title: Umana
text: Danceable AfroBeat and reggae from 8 to 10 pm. We hope to come again to share the beats, share the vibes, and have you dance your night away.

title: Parish Public House, with Mosaic Foundation
text: Parish Public House hosted Mosaic Foundation and had us open the stage and warm up the dance floor.

title: Alive at Five, opening for Third World
text: Mixed Roots graced the City of Albany with AfroBeat and reggae, opening for Grammy-nominated, world-renowned Third World. We enjoyed the sun as it approached 96 degrees in the shade. After the show a few of us got to take photos with Third World.

title: Albany Public Library
place: Main Branch, 161 Washington Ave., Albany, NY
text: Connecting with our community is always fun. Bringing AfroBeat and reggae all around the Northeast is our pleasure.

title: Franklin Alley Social Club
text: The social club expanded into the alley it is named for, and we enjoyed the sun and shade, danced, and played simultaneously. Photo credit to Heather, our guitarist's wife.

title: Dinosaur Bar-B-Que
text: We played our hearts out! Thank you to all who danced and cheered and had a great time!

title: ACLU benefit
place: Tavern at the A, Pittsfield, MA
text: Pittsfield has a big local reggae scene, and we were excited to be invited to make music with them. It was a blast!

title: The Savoy, with DJ Trumastr
text: We traded sets with DJ Trumastr, arguably Albany's best AfroBeat-spinning musician.

title: The Linda
text: Part of the Linda's local music showcases.

title: Grassroots Radio Conference
place: Grand Street Community Arts, Albany, NY
text: Hosted at the home of Albany's local grassroots station, WCAA.
